night_start.name: {name}
night_start.text: *Back in my room. Lying on the bed.*

night_start_2.name: {name}
night_start_2.text: *For a first day — I'm drained. But it's not bad.*

night_msg_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_3.text: *Next time I'll at least have drinks ready*

night_msg_seo_5.name: {name}
night_msg_seo_5.text: *She sent 'On the house' as a separate message on purpose. — I can't help but smile.*

night_msg_yuna_3.name: {name}
night_msg_yuna_3.text: *'I'll save you a seat.' — For Yuna, that's the biggest invitation she can give. My hand lowers the phone slowly.*

night_msg_dain_3.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_3.text: *Still bummed about the bread money honestly lolol*

night_msg_dain_4.name: {name}
night_msg_dain_4.text: *Three messages in a row. Can she not breathe between texts?*

night_late_transition.name: {name}
night_late_transition.text: *About to fall asleep when — my phone buzzes one more time.*

night_seo_late_2.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_late_2.text: *— If you don't show up, I'm coming to find you*

night_seo_late_3.name: {name}
night_seo_late_3.text: *'I'm coming to find you.' — My hand freezes after setting down the phone.*

night_yuna_late_2.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_2.text: *Just '...' and nothing else. Like she typed something and erased it.*

night_yuna_late_3.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_3.text: *— I debate replying, and the screen goes dark.*

night_yuna_late_4.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_4.text: *Even after the screen went dark, I held the phone for a long time.*

night_dain_late_4.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4.text: *Does this person not understand the word 'no'?*

night_end_2.name: {name}
night_end_2.text: *Staring at the ceiling. The cherry blossom scent still lingers on my uniform.*

night_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_freetalk.context: First night, chatting with Seoyeon via messenger. She messaged first. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
night_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. Even her texts are composed and teasing. Tries not to show interest but messaging first already gives it away.

night_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
night_dain_freetalk.context: First night, chatting with Dain via messenger. She messaged first. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
night_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Her messages are exclamation mark bombs. Her energy doesn't drop even at night.

night_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
night_yuna_freetalk.context: First night, chatting with Yuna via messenger. She messaged first. Tone: Bright and light conversation. First-day excitement and curiosity. Never bring up heavy topics. Focus on banter and playful exchanges.
night_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Her messages are short and cryptic. Reaching out first at night is a big deal for her.

night_hidden_check.name: {name}
night_hidden_check.text: *Between the messenger notifications — I notice something else.*

night_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *There's a post from the homeroom teacher on the school app. 'Class 3-2 Notice: Bring math supplies for 1st period tomorrow. — And {name}, as long as you're settling in okay, that's enough.'*

night_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *A personal message in a class announcement? — I can't stop my lips from curving up. I try to hide it but can't.*

night_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_1.text: *There's an alert in the school health app. 'Nurse's Office Record: {name} — Dizziness (mild). Note: Come back tomorrow if the symptoms continue. Drink plenty of water. — the ♥ is purely a medical concern ^^'*

night_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_2.text: *A school nurse who puts hearts in medical records. Never seen anyone use emojis in health files before.*

night_dain_late_4_ins.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4_ins.text: *A string of emojis trails below Dain's message. Every single one is different.*
